text:
maria: Heads-up — I ran linkcheck on the Console/Observability quickstart PR and it flagged a few external docs that are 404ing plus one large example causing the page to time out when rendering.
owen: ugh, which example? the big dashboard JSON? :grimacing:
tess: I noticed the same during local preview — `dashboard-presets.json` is ~1.8MB, might be loading the whole example rather than a trimmed excerpt.
maria: exact. Also found three orphaned refs to an internal gdoc (old pricing matrix) that we should either remove or swap to an internal redirect.
elaine: tagging for prioritization — @tess can you open a tiny PR to strip the example down to a minimal reproducible snippet? keep the full artifact in /samples but not inline.
tess: yep. plan: 1) cut the inline JSON to a short sample (~12 lines) 2) add a "full sample" download link that points to /samples/observability-dashboard.json 3) replace the gdoc links with `internal://docs/pricing-matrix` redirect where appropriate.
frank: I can handle the redirect mapping in the docs redirect table — which paths need redirects?
maria: the three are: `/docs/console/costs#breakdown`, `/docs/console/tracing#pricing`, and `/guides/onboard/pricing-ref`. all currently point to gdoc `docs.google.com/old/pricing`
frank: got it — I'll add entries to the redirects file and mark them as 302 until legal signs off.
deploy-bot: docs site build started for branch `docs/obs-quickstart-fix`
maria: one more: the tracing hook example references `trace_id` being passed as a header but our SDK examples use `X-Redwood-Trace`. need to align.
owen: thanks for catching. I can update the Python and Typescript snippets to use `X-Redwood-Trace` and keep a note about older integrations.
tess: small snippet diff (wip):
```
# before
headers = {"trace_id": trace}
# after
headers = {"X-Redwood-Trace": trace}
```
elaine: prefer to add a short footnote instead of removing mention of `trace_id` — some customers still send it and we should document mapping.
frank: will include a mapping table in the redirects/compat doc.
maria: timeline? would like this merged before Monday so the public site build doesn't keep failing in nightly linkcheck.
tess: I can open the PR in ~90m with trimmed example and snippet updates.
owen: I'll follow up with the SDK PR to sync the examples (Python + TS).
frank: redirects PR after mine is queued.
deploy-bot: docs site build completed — linkcheck failed (3 broken external links).
maria: thanks all — assigning reviewers: @tess for content, @owen for code snippets, @frank for redirects. I'll do a quick smoke preview once PRs are green. :thumbsup:
tess: ack, ping me when branch is up. :eyes:
